1.4. Connection to Gaussian multiplicative chaos. We now explain the connection
between our variance (which we think of as mean squares of random Euler products
like (1.2)) and the theory of Gaussian multiplicative chaos, restricting ourselves to the
Steinhaus case. For an introduction to the theory, see Rhodes and Vargas [29]. A similar
discussion can be found in the introduction of Harper [15]. Here, we put a particular
emphasis on understanding the limiting distribution of our variances.
